title: Built out a gameplay teaser for my work in progress RTS
author: Uncled1023
selftext:
Hi everyone!

  
I've been a software engineer for the past decade, and I've been working on (with Claude/Codex) an RTS for the past few months.  I was initially inspired by my love for Empire Earth, and the world of Redwall, but the eventual story I landed with is not anywhere close to the series.  It's not really baked into the game as much currently as there is no campaign yet, but there are tidbits in there currently and i'll be adding some additional ways of learning about it (maybe through like archeological mechanics, or some sort of lore drops)?

My current stack is Claude Code with some usage of Codex, Blender for the models, and Godot for the game engine (using C# for the scripting).  

It's currently playable vs AI opponents (up to 8 players), with different ai strategies.  Each map is procedural generated and each individual aspect of the map is changeable in settings (rivers, mountains, elevation, resources, etc).

Some of the features i'm excited about:

* Rivers/Dams: dams make rivers beyond it cross-able, but if destroyed, temporarily floods downriver.
* Tunnels/Bridges: building tunnels through mountain ranges/impassable routes, and having bridges able to be built across valleys and other terrain, not just rivers.
* Night influences gameplay: during night, line of sight is decreased, and light can increase it.  Units can turn on and off their personal lights, so they can sneak up on units to gain advantage.

Of course I have a bunch of ideas, but i'm trying to keep my goals manageable for now to avoid scope creep.  It's hard though.  😅 

My current still in progress aspects are the tech tree, diplomacy, some additional models, and overall balance changes.  

What are your thoughts on the trailer?  And the current UI?  I've been in my own world, so any feedback is extremely useful.
